ns2:section.sectionText: A limited number of seats will continue to open through December 8. Should the course be full when attempting to register, it is suggested that students "favorite" the course through the Course Explorer and request email notifications from the system about open seats. They often become available through the 10th day of courses. Please note: This section will have synchronous (live) sessions, to be held during the scheduled class day/time listed in Course Explorer.
